summary: Avoid discarded harness and claim-history reductions in the terminals collection.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection recovery changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule change.

compatibility.detail: Terminals list responses retain the existing runtime authority, selected owner, incarnation, access and snapshot fields. Runtime control and full status keep the full reducer.

manual.detail: No setting or store repair required.

recovery.detail: No persisted cache or migration; normal binary rollback drops process-local reductions.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart; duration not measured for this change.
